subject: cult-info-b
title: (R)CULT.INFO.B.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in The Midwest (and West Coast) Continuum section (MID-W-3), the first of two on book p409. (R)CULT-INFO-B (the reality of culture information basis) is crossed with AFL-DY (affinity dynamics, marked with the (dt) prefix — Braxton's CODE for 'determines the ____ of its ____', meaning affinity dynamics here is functioning as a *determining* relation rather than a relational one). The diagram poses what real culture-information-basis crossed with the determining role of affinity dynamics looks like for a midwest creative community. INFO-DS (information dissemination) branches from the main line and opens into (R)TM (real terminology—or terms of a definition) and MT-INFO (multi-information); MT-INFO opens into C-INFO (composite information) → POL-DYM (political dynamics) → (R)INT (real intention). PROG-SIGN (progressional significance) branches from the main line. A dotted line runs from AFL-DY to INFO-RT (information reality), which opens into PART (participation).
